site.name: Cirata Floating Solar PV
site.location_note: Coordinates are the Cirata hydro dam; the array may sit a few km away, so the location is approximate.
site.altitude_note: Assumed approximate reservoir surface level; affects only air pressure in the clear-sky and sun-position calculations.

tilt_deg.label: Module tilt
tilt_deg.basis: Floating arrays are typically low tilt. Held fixed; build reports yield at 5 and 15 deg as a sensitivity.

azimuth_deg.label: Module azimuth
azimuth_deg.basis: North-facing assumed for a southern-hemisphere site. An east-west layout would change the daily shape; not modelled.

gcr.label: Ground coverage ratio (row spacing)
gcr.basis: Floating arrays are packed densely; no Cirata layout data. Higher GCR = more row shading.

row_width_m.label: Row width (module slant length)
row_width_m.basis: Sets row pitch together with GCR; layout not verified.

height_m.label: Module height above water
height_m.basis: Typical pontoon float height; only affects rear-side light.

bifaciality.label: Bifaciality factor
bifaciality.basis: Module model not verified. Low = monofacial; mid/high = typical glass-glass bifacial.

float_cover.label: Share of surface under array that is float, not water
float_cover.basis: Float design not verified. Floats are lighter than water, raising rear-side light.

float_albedo.label: Float surface albedo
float_albedo.basis: White HDPE floats; no measured value found, so wide range.

u_value.label: Module heat-loss coefficient (cooling)
u_value.basis: Low = PVsyst free-standing land default (no water cooling credit). Dorenkamper et al. 2021 (Solar Energy 214) report FPV heat-loss coefficients higher than land systems, smaller in the low-wind tropics than in temperate sites; values recalled from the paper, not re-checked, so the range is deliberately wide.

temp_coeff.label: Power temperature coefficient
temp_coeff.basis: Typical range for PERC to TOPCon/HJT datasheets; module model not verified.

soiling.label: Soiling loss (dust, bird droppings)
soiling.basis: Heavy rain washes panels, but bird droppings are a known FPV issue; no Cirata data.

mismatch_wiring.label: Mismatch, DC wiring and wave motion
mismatch_wiring.basis: Typical design-tool defaults widened for float movement.

availability.label: Availability (uptime)
availability.basis: No outage data published. Grid curtailment is NOT modelled.

inverter_eff.label: Inverter nominal efficiency
inverter_eff.basis: Inverter details not verified; typical central/string inverter range.

ac_loss.label: AC loss to export point (transformers, cables)
ac_loss.basis: Typical range; grid connection details not verified.

humidity_degradation.label: Extra degradation from humid over-water environment
humidity_degradation.basis: No reliable published value found; placeholder range covering zero to a pessimistic extra.

tariff_usd_kwh.label: Electricity sale price (PPA tariff)
tariff_usd_kwh.basis: Commonly quoted near 5.8 US cents/kWh in press; not verified here.

capex_musd.label: Capital cost
capex_musd.basis: Widely reported order of US$100-130 million; not verified.

household_kwh_yr.label: Household electricity use
household_kwh_yr.basis: Indonesian household consumption not verified; wide range. Low end of 'homes powered' uses the highest use.

grid_ef_t_mwh.label: Java-Bali grid emission factor
grid_ef_t_mwh.basis: Coal-heavy grid; official factor not verified here.

reported.label: Inauguration to June 2024
reported.note: Primary source, cumulative. End taken as 30 June 2024. Unknown whether pre-inauguration commissioning output is included.

reported.label: Calendar 2024
reported.note: Secondary report. Conflicts slightly with the AGM figure below.

reported.label: AGM 2025 figure (probably 2024)
reported.note: Year not stated in the report; assumed to be calendar 2024.

claimed_annual_gwh.note: Design or press claims, not measurements.
